notes:
V3.0.1 — in-app account switching.

• User chip in the top-right header is now clickable. Drop-down menu offers 'Switch account' and 'Sign out' — both go through the same clear-token → login-window flow but let you express intent. Previously you had to dig into the system tray to sign out.

• On re-login the FRIENDS tab refreshes against the new account so you immediately see that account's requests + friends list (instead of stale data from the previous user). The currently-visible bot tab and any cloud-bot resume pass also re-fire.

• Drop-down styled to match the dark theme (matches the rest of the app's QMenu look).

Useful for testing the new friends flow: sign in as Account 1, send a friend request, click the chip → Switch account → sign in as Account 2, accept the request, click View on the friend row.
